_comment: JEDEC JEP-106 manufacturer codes — packed (bank << 8) | (id_byte & 0x7F). The codes themselves are uncopyrightable factual data; the names below are sourced from the public JEP-106 registry and verified against vendor datasheets. Add entries as your fleet requires; tools/memspd.c falls back to printing the raw hex when a code is not present.
